{{Quote|Get a scanning crew in here on the double! I want every part of this ship checked!|Captain Khurgee to his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] subordinates|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Khurgee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] who served aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's no one on board, sir. According to the log, the crew abandoned ship right after takeoff|Khurgee explaining to Darth Vader|<ref name="ANH" />}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Khurgee was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking-bay]] security officer, and was also a [[Helm officer/Legends|helmsman]] by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. He served first aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderflare]]'', where he was honored for bravery after rescuing five officers from a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash. He was later assigned to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="ANH" />

While the [[Space station/Legends|battle station]] lingered in the rubble of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]], Khurgee was the security officer in charge of searching the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]]. He led the initial inspection in person, and reported to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], before summoning a scanner team to perform a more thorough search. Not too long after, the Death Star saw its destruction in the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khurgee's biography derives largely from his card in the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].

Among Star Wars fans, there is a relatively widespread belief that Khurgee held the rank of [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Line Captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. However, there is no [[canon]] support for this statement, which seems to derive from the [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]] website's interpretation of his [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia]].<ref name="TheForce">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/swtc/insignia/badges.html#linecaptain|text=Imperial Insignia: Officer Examples|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20210126023501}}</ref>

Although he is not credited in the film, Khurgee was played by actor [[Christopher Muncke]].<ref name="Wattographs">{{WebCite|url=http://www.wattographs.com/Recollections/RecollectionsChrisMuncke.aspx Interview with Christopher Muncke|text=MinimizeLiving a Life Forcefully: A Muncke's Tale|work=Wattographs|archivedate=20120406165452}}</ref> His voiced was dubbed by [[Harry Shearer]].

The novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] incorrectly identifies Khurgee as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].
